Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
This grill is replacing a Weber Genesis Silver A that I have had for 20 years (outside). After such a great experience, a new Weber was the only way to go. The Spirit II....I love the well built base, the electronic igniter (has worked every time so far). Most of all, this grill holds a set temperature very well. I have done ribs on it already, and they came out great using indirect heat. The stainless side tables, front panel are nice touches, though they will need frequent cleaning.

The only thing to consider is size. I think it could cook for up to 8 with no problem, but for $100 more the E-310 gives you another burner and a slightly bigger cooking area. I don't need this, but it is worth consideration.

The only downside is that Weber used to offer the Spirit II series in 4 colors. I really wanted sapphire, but now you can only get black (mine) or stainless steel. 

I think that this is a great grill and am really happy to see that the E-210 matches or exceeds my old Silver A in so many ways.
Results.Title: Can't recommend this enough!

Results.ReviewText: Weber makes a quality gas grill. Everything feels well finished and substantial. There's not a cheap-feeling part to be found. I particularly appreciate the built-in thermometer and the disposable aluminum grease pan that's affordable and easy to replace. Everything is easily accessible/removable for cleaning. I'd definitely recommend spending more on this over a cheaply made alternative. A grill is the kind of thing I want to buy and keep not have to replace every year or two, so build quality and ease of cleaning is important. The grill heats up quickly and does a good job maintaining temperature. I've only had it a short while and used it a couple of times, but so far no complaints in terms of cooking performance.
Results.Title: Excellent Build Quality & Function

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
